text: Excuse me. I need a new computer. What's the price range for your laptops?
Well, our lowest-priced laptop is only three hundred twenty-nine ninety-nine. Our highest-priced model costs two thousand one hundred ninety nine ninety nine.
That's expensive! Can you tell me about the low-priced one?
Well, it's fine for basic use, if you don't play games much.
Well, I am a big gamer, but I don't want to spend over a thousand dollars. though.
This model has a lot of power, and it only costs seven hundred ninety nine dollars. It's very popular.
Hmm, let me take a look.
